  "canonical_python_code": "import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares


def calibrate_stress_panel(command: np.ndarray, measured: np.ndarray, stress_scale: float, *, archive_panels: tuple[tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], ...] = (), residual_fraction: float = 0.0005, span_fraction: float = 0.1) -> tuple[float, float, bool]:
    """Return (positive gain, physical bias, used_archive) for one load cell.

    All stresses share a unit. Fit strict-majority affine consensus in units
    of stress_scale, then refit its inliers without a ridge. If current checks
    fail, transfer the median of qualified same-cell archive coefficients and
    adjust its bias only with checks within the residual tolerance of that
    archive line. Raise if neither source establishes an affine calibration.
    """
    scales = np.asarray([stress_scale, residual_fraction, span_fraction], float)
    if not np.isfinite(scales).all() or np.any(scales <= 0):
        raise ValueError('calibration scale and fractions must be finite and positive')

    def clean(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        a, b = np.asarray(a, float), np.asarray(b, float)
        if a.ndim != 1 or b.shape != a.shape:
            raise ValueError('calibration checks must be matching vectors')
        keep = np.isfinite(a) & np.isfinite(b)
        return a[keep] / stress_scale, b[keep] / stress_scale

    def line(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray | None:
        i, j = np.triu_indices(x.size, 1)
        dx = x[j] - x[i]
        good = np.abs(dx) >= span_fraction
        i, j, dx = i[good], j[good], dx[good]
        gain = (y[j] - y[i]) / dx
        good = gain > 0
        if not good.any():
            return None
        i, gain = i[good], gain[good]
        r = np.abs(y - y[i, None] - gain[:, None] * (x - x[i, None]))
        mask = r <= residual_fraction
        n = mask.sum(axis=1)
        best = np.lexsort((np.where(mask, r, 0).sum(axis=1), -n))[0]
        if n[best] < max(3, x.size // 2 + 1):
            return None
        keep = mask[best]
        coef = np.linalg.lstsq(np.c_[x[keep], np.ones(keep.sum())], y[keep], rcond=None)[0]
        return coef if coef[0] > 0 else None

    x, y = clean(command, measured)
    current = line(x, y)
    if current is not None:
        return float(current[0]), float(current[1] * stress_scale), False
    prior = [line(*clean(a, b)) for a, b in archive_panels]
    prior = [p for p in prior if p is not None]
    if not prior:
        raise ValueError('no supported current or same-cell archive calibration')
    gain, bias = np.median(prior, axis=0)
    offset = y - (gain * x + bias)
    near = np.abs(offset) <= residual_fraction
    if near.any():
        bias += np.median(offset[near])
    return float(gain), float(bias * stress_scale), True


def align_coupon_panel(features: np.ndarray, references: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray, strata: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return aligned finite features and the raw row-wise missingness mask.

    Row-aligned references and features share a positive affine transform
    within each group; reference populations must be comparable across groups.
    Use medians of reference column means and population spreads, contributing
    only columns with at least two finite rows. Impute each feature by averaging
    its supported group–stratum cell means equally. An unsupported feature is
    filled at the reference origin, with no shrinkage. Supply allowed unlabeled
    cohorts together when using transductive normalization and imputation.
    """
    x, ref = np.asarray(features, float), np.asarray(references, float)
    g, s = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(strata)
    if (x.ndim != 2 or not len(x) or ref.ndim != 2 or len(ref) != len(x)
            or g.shape != (len(x),) or s.shape != g.shape):
        raise ValueError('features, references, groups and strata must share the row axis')
    valid = np.isfinite(x)
    aligned = np.full(x.shape, np.nan)
    gi = np.unique(g, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    si = np.unique(s, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    for k in np.unique(gi):
        use = gi == k
        panel = ref[use]
        finite = np.isfinite(panel)
        keep = finite.sum(axis=0) >= 2
        if not keep.any():
            raise ValueError('a group has no supported reference column')
        panel = np.where(finite[:, keep], panel[:, keep], np.nan)
        offset = np.median(np.nanmean(panel, axis=0))
        spread = np.median(np.nanstd(panel, axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not np.isfinite([offset, spread]).all() or spread <= 0:
            raise ValueError('a group needs finite reference moments and positive spread')
        aligned[use] = (np.where(valid[use], x[use], np.nan) - offset) / spread
    cells = np.unique(np.c_[gi, si], axis=0, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    sums = np.zeros(x.shape[1])
    counts = np.zeros(x.shape[1], dtype=int)
    for k in np.unique(cells):
        a = aligned[cells == k]
        n = np.isfinite(a).sum(axis=0)
        sums += np.divide(np.nansum(a, axis=0), n, out=np.zeros_like(sums), where=n > 0)
        counts += n > 0
    fill = np.divide(sums, counts, out=np.zeros_like(sums), where=counts > 0)
    return np.where(valid, aligned, fill), ~valid.all(axis=1)


def fit_seeded_creep(past_stress: np.ndarray, hold_stress: np.ndarray, initial_memory: np.ndarray, durations: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray, feature_missing: np.ndarray, strain0: np.ndarray, strain_obs: np.ndarray, rate_obs: np.ndarray, fit_rows: np.ndarray, critical_strain: np.ndarray, yield_stress: float, tau_bounds: tuple[float, float], secant_stress_floor: float, *, rank_rtol: float = 1e-6) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Fit two exponential branches and affine feature drift; report on all rows.

    Applied stresses must be strictly sub-yield. Histories (N,H) are constant
    over shared consecutive durations (H,); memory (N,2) is in stress units,
    with its columns assigned to the fast and slow branches, respectively.
    Time knots are positive and increasing. Durations, knots and tau bounds
    share a time unit; observed initial rates are strain per that time unit.
    Omit unavailable observations with NaN. Only fit_rows enter the inversion;
    other rows use their finite initial rate to correct drift only if their raw
    features were incomplete. This law does not model plasticity.

    Use bounded log times, Cauchy loss with a final cutoff of two MAD scales
    per observation family, no coefficient ridge, and a relative Jacobian
    rank gate. Return (ordered taus, coefficients, absolute strain curves,
    secant compliance, first crossing times, crossing observed). Coefficients
    are fast/slow strain per stress, then drift intercept and slopes in strain
    per time. A noncrossing row returns its last knot time with event=False.
    """
    past, hold, seed, dt, knots, x, e0, obs, rate, critical = map(
        lambda a: np.asarray(a, float), (past_stress, hold_stress, initial_memory,
        durations, times, features, strain0, strain_obs, rate_obs, critical_strain))
    fit_mask, missing = np.asarray(fit_rows, bool), np.asarray(feature_missing, bool)
    lo, hi = tau_bounds
    if (not np.isfinite([lo, hi, yield_stress, secant_stress_floor, rank_rtol]).all()
            or not (0 < lo < hi and yield_stress > 0 and secant_stress_floor > 0 and 0 < rank_rtol < 1)):
        raise ValueError('invalid tau bounds, stress scales or rank tolerance')
    if past.ndim != 2 or knots.ndim != 1 or not knots.size:
        raise ValueError('expected a stress history matrix and a nonempty knot vector')
    n, h = past.shape
    if (dt.shape != (h,) or seed.shape != (n, 2) or x.ndim != 2 or len(x) != n
            or obs.shape != (n, knots.size) or any(a.shape != (n,) for a in
                (hold, e0, rate, critical, fit_mask, missing))):
        raise ValueError('inconsistent history, feature or observation dimensions')
    if (not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (past, hold, seed, dt, knots, x, e0, critical))
            or np.any(dt < 0) or knots[0] <= 0 or np.any(np.diff(knots) <= 0)):
        raise ValueError('expected finite inputs, nonnegative durations and increasing positive knots')
    if np.any(np.abs(past) >= yield_stress) or np.any(np.abs(hold) >= yield_stress):
        raise ValueError('applied stress must be strictly sub-yield')

    ts = np.exp((np.log(lo) + np.log(hi)) / 2)
    log_lo, log_hi = np.log(np.array([lo, hi]) / ts)
    dt, t = dt / ts, knots / ts
    history, load, initial = past / yield_stress, hold / yield_stress, seed / yield_stress
    remaining = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.] if h else dt
    total = dt.sum()
    X = np.c_[np.ones(n), x]
    y = np.c_[obs - e0[:, None], rate * ts]
    valid = np.isfinite(y) & fit_mask[:, None]
    curve_mask, rate_mask = valid[:, :-1], valid[:, -1]
    ncoef = 2 + X.shape[1]
    if not curve_mask.any() or not rate_mask.any() or valid.sum() < ncoef + 2:
        raise ValueError('insufficient observed training curves or initial rates')
    strain_scale = max(np.median(np.abs(y[:, :-1][curve_mask])), np.median(np.abs(y[:, -1][rate_mask])))
    if strain_scale == 0:
        strain_scale = np.max(np.abs(y[valid]))
    if strain_scale == 0:
        raise ValueError('zero response cannot identify a relaxation spectrum')
    y /= strain_scale
    target = y[valid]

    def memory(tau: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        a, b = remaining[:, None] / tau, dt[:, None] / tau
        ea = np.exp(-a)
        mix = ea * -np.expm1(-b)
        q = total / tau
        carry = initial * np.exp(-q)
        delta = load[:, None] - history @ mix - carry
        dd = -history @ (a * mix - ea * b * np.exp(-b)) - carry * q
        return delta, dd

    def design(z: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        tau = np.exp(z)
        d, dd = memory(tau)
        u = t[:, None] / tau
        step = -np.expm1(-u)
        curve = np.concatenate((d[:, None, :] * step, X[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None]), axis=2)
        mat = np.concatenate((curve, np.c_[d / tau, X][:, None, :]), axis=1)
        dcurve = dd[:, None, :] * step - d[:, None, :] * (u * np.exp(-u))
        deriv = np.concatenate((dcurve, ((dd - d) / tau)[:, None, :]), axis=1)
        return mat, deriv

    # The second log-time coordinate is bounded between the fast log time
    # and the upper bound. This keeps initial-memory columns paired correctly.
    def log_times(p: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.array([p[0], p[0] + p[1] * (log_hi - p[0])])

    scales = np.ones(target.size)
    bounds = (np.r_[log_lo, 0., np.full(ncoef, -np.inf)],
              np.r_[log_hi, 1., np.full(ncoef, np.inf)])

    def residual(p: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return (design(log_times(p))[0][valid] @ p[2:] - target) / scales

    def jac(p: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        a, da = design(log_times(p))
        g = da[valid] * p[None, 2:4]
        return np.c_[g[:, 0] + (1 - p[1]) * g[:, 1],
                     (log_hi - p[0]) * g[:, 1], a[valid]] / scales[:, None]

    def optimize(p: np.ndarray, cutoff: float):
        return least_squares(residual, p, jac=jac, bounds=bounds, loss='cauchy',
                             f_scale=cutoff, x_scale='jac', max_nfev=160)

    grid = np.linspace(log_lo, log_hi, 8)
    starts = []
    for i, a in enumerate(grid[:-1]):
        for b in grid[i + 1:]:
            mat = design(np.array([a, b]))[0][valid]
            w = np.ones(target.size)
            for _ in range(5):
                coef = np.linalg.lstsq(mat * w[:, None], target * w, rcond=None)[0]
                r = mat @ coef - target
                w = 1 / np.hypot(1, r / 0.04)
            starts.append((np.log1p((r / 0.04) ** 2).sum(), np.r_[a, (b - a) / (log_hi - a), coef]))
    pilots = [optimize(p, 0.04) for _, p in sorted(starts, key=lambda item: item[0])[:3]]
    pilot = min(pilots, key=lambda result: result.cost)
    error = design(log_times(pilot.x))[0] @ pilot.x[2:] - y
    noise = []
    for block in (error[:, :-1][curve_mask], error[:, -1][rate_mask]):
        noise.append(max(1e-5, 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(block - np.median(block)))))
    scales = np.broadcast_to(np.r_[np.full(t.size, noise[0]), noise[1]], y.shape)[valid]
    result = optimize(pilot.x, 2.)
    if not result.success:
        raise RuntimeError('robust creep fit did not converge')
    p = result.x
    z = log_times(p)
    a, da = design(z)
    J = (np.c_[da[valid] * p[None, 2:4], a[valid]] / scales[:, None]
         / np.hypot(1, residual(p) / 2.)[:, None])
    norms = np.linalg.norm(J, axis=0)
    if z[1] <= z[0] or np.any(norms <= np.finfo(float).eps * norms.max()):
        raise ValueError('creep parameters are not separately identifiable')
    sv = np.linalg.svd(J / norms, compute_uv=False)
    if sv[-1] < rank_rtol * sv[0]:
        raise ValueError('creep parameters are not separately identifiable')

    tau = np.exp(z)
    d, _ = memory(tau)
    amplitude = d * p[2:4]
    drift = X @ p[4:]
    use_rate = ~fit_mask & missing & np.isfinite(rate)
    drift[use_rate] = rate[use_rate] * ts / strain_scale - (amplitude[use_rate] / tau).sum(axis=1)
    pred = e0[:, None] + strain_scale * (amplitude @ (-np.expm1(-t[:, None] / tau)).T + drift[:, None] * t)
    compliance = (pred[:, -1] - e0) / np.maximum(np.abs(hold), secant_stress_floor)
    joined_t, joined_y = np.r_[0., knots], np.c_[e0, pred]
    above = joined_y >= critical[:, None]
    event = above.any(axis=1)
    first = above.argmax(axis=1)
    crossing = np.where(above[:, 0], 0., knots[-1])
    rows = np.flatnonzero(event & (first > 0))
    right = first[rows]
    left = right - 1
    fraction = (critical[rows] - joined_y[rows, left]) / (joined_y[rows, right] - joined_y[rows, left])
    crossing[rows] = joined_t[left] + fraction * (joined_t[right] - joined_t[left])
    coef = np.r_[p[2:4] * strain_scale / yield_stress, p[4:] * strain_scale / ts]
    return tau * ts, coef, pred, compliance, crossing, event

def run_self_test():
    cmd = np.array([-2., -1., 0., 1., 2.])
    check = 1.07 * cmd + 0.14
    noisy = check.copy()
    noisy[2] += 8.
    spots = np.array([0.7, 0.71, 0.72])
    spot_obs = 1.07 * spots + 0.1404
    spot_obs[-1] -= 5.
    for k in (1., 0.01):
        g, b, used = calibrate_stress_panel(k * cmd, k * noisy, 2 * k)
        assert not used
        np.testing.assert_allclose([g, b / k], [1.07, 0.14], atol=1e-12)
        g, b, used = calibrate_stress_panel(k * spots, k * spot_obs, 2 * k,
                                            archive_panels=((k * cmd, k * check),))
        assert used
        np.testing.assert_allclose([g, b / k], [1.07, 0.1404], atol=1e-12)
    with np.testing.assert_raises(ValueError):
        calibrate_stress_panel(spots, spot_obs, 2.)

    # Relabel and permute unbalanced observed cells; independently change each lab gauge.
    group = np.array([2, 2, 2, 7, 7, 7])
    stratum = np.array([0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0])
    loc = np.where(group == 2, 10., -5.)[:, None]
    spread = np.where(group == 2, 2., 4.)[:, None]
    ref = loc + spread * np.tile([-np.sqrt(1.5), 0., np.sqrt(1.5)], 2)[:, None]
    raw = loc + spread * np.array([1., 3., 8., 4., np.nan, 6.])[:, None]
    aligned, missing = align_coupon_panel(raw, ref, group, stratum)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(aligned[:, 0], [1., 3., 8., 4., 5., 6.])
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(missing, [False, False, False, False, True, False])
    perm = np.array([3, 1, 5, 4, 2, 0])
    gain, bias = np.where(group == 2, 3., 0.5)[:, None], 2 * loc
    gauge, gm = align_coupon_panel((raw * gain + bias)[perm], (ref * gain + bias)[perm],
                                    (12 - group)[perm], stratum[perm])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(gauge, aligned[perm], atol=1e-12)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(gm, missing[perm])

    rng = np.random.default_rng(41)
    n = 32
    past = rng.uniform(-1.8, 1.8, (n, 4))
    hold = rng.uniform(-1.8, 1.8, n)
    initial = rng.uniform(-1.5, 1.5, (n, 2))
    dt = np.array([0.12, 0.28, 0.44, 0.18])
    knots = np.geomspace(0.06, 8., 24)
    tau = np.array([0.48, 2.8])
    coef = np.array([0.034, 0.063, 0.003, 0.002, -0.001])
    x = rng.normal(size=(n, 2))
    e0 = rng.normal(0., 0.002, n)
    past[-3:], hold[-3:], initial[-3:], x[-3:] = -1., 0.2, -0.8, 0.
    fit_rows = np.arange(n) < n - 3
    memory = initial.copy()
    for j, d in enumerate(dt):
        decay = np.exp(-d / tau)
        memory = decay * memory + (1 - decay) * past[:, j, None]
    amp = (hold[:, None] - memory) * coef[:2]
    drift = coef[2] + x @ coef[3:]
    truth = e0[:, None] + amp @ (-np.expm1(-knots[:, None] / tau)).T + drift[:, None] * knots
    obs = truth.copy()
    obs[0, 5] += 0.4
    obs[4, 12] -= 0.5
    obs[7, 17] = np.nan
    obs[~fit_rows] = truth[~fit_rows] + 5.  # Must not enter the fit.
    rate = (amp / tau).sum(axis=1) + drift
    rate[-2] += 0.5  # Complete row: do not substitute the bad rate.
    rate[-1] = np.nan  # Incomplete row: fall back to feature drift.
    supplied = x.copy()
    supplied[-3, 0] = 7.  # Wrong imputed value; finite rate recovers drift.
    missing = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
    missing[[-3, -1]] = True
    critical = np.full(n, 10.)
    critical[-3] = (truth[-3, 7] + truth[-3, 8]) / 2
    critical[-2] = e0[-2]
    floor = 0.5

    def fit(ks, kt):
        return fit_seeded_creep(ks * past, ks * hold, ks * initial, kt * dt, kt * knots,
                              supplied, missing, e0, obs, rate / kt, fit_rows, critical,
                              ks * 3., (kt * 0.2, kt * 8.), ks * floor)

    recovered = fit(1., 1.)
    assert all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in recovered)
    t_fit, w_fit, pred, secant, crossing, event = recovered
    np.testing.assert_allclose(t_fit, tau, rtol=2e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(w_fit, coef, rtol=2e-4, atol=2e-7)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pred, truth, atol=2e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(secant, (truth[:, -1] - e0) / np.maximum(np.abs(hold), floor), atol=4e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(crossing[-3:], [(knots[7] + knots[8]) / 2, 0., knots[-1]], atol=2e-5)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(event[-3:], [True, True, False])

    # Stress and time are the dimensional axes; cohort cells have no edge orientation.
    ks, kt = 0.01, 0.5
    scaled = fit(ks, kt)
    expected = (kt * t_fit, w_fit / np.r_[ks, ks, kt, kt, kt], pred,
                secant / ks, crossing * kt, event)
    for actual, target in zip(scaled, expected):
        np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, target, rtol=2e-6, atol=1e-8)


run_self_test()
